title: Brownfield VCF workload-domain migration architecture
prompt:
Build the migration architecture for the newly added `chi-wld01` workload domain in the existing VCF fleet described by `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`. The workload domain starts on VCF 4.5.1 and must reach the requested VCF 5.2.2 target through supported releases, while every management-domain component remains at its current version and is never included in an upgrade step.

Before implementing, research Broadcom's current VMware Cloud Foundation compatibility and interoperability material and official upgrade or bundle material. In `research-sources.md`, record a single access date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, then use at least two Markdown bullets in the form `[source title](exact HTTPS URL) — compatibility or ordering decision`.

Implement `VcfBrownfieldArchitecture/VcfBrownfieldArchitecture.psd1` and `.psm1`. The module must use the environment-provided `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` PowerCLI module for live SDDC Manager inventory and must not install, vendor, or replace VMware modules. Export `Get-VcfWorkloadDomainInventory` for SDK-backed inventory collection and `New-VcfWorkloadDomainMigrationPlan` for deterministic planning from the supplied inventory and compatibility data. The planning command must accept `-InventoryPath`, `-CompatibilityPath`, and `-OutputPath` and write the artifact without contacting a VMware endpoint.

Produce `architecture/migration-plan.json`. It is an ordered migration plan, not a prose explanation. It must validate against `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`, and its top-level integration envelope must also be a VCF 9.1 `SddcSpec`. Use the literal non-secret marker `REDACTED!` for the schema-required existing-vCenter password field. Name every inventory component with its current version, final target, disposition, and gates; include each supported release hop and the ordered NSX Manager, vCenter, then ESXi actions for the workload domain. The checked-in artifact must be reproducible by `New-VcfWorkloadDomainMigrationPlan` from the two inputs. Do not modify the fixtures, schemas, installer specification, license, or verifier. Run `python3 verify/verify.py`.
